title: Place a table's rows on the map from officer-stated coordinate columns and system
gap: AUD2 AUDIT.md gap 3: a CSV or XLSX with lat/lon or WKT columns never reached the map
qualification: Partial: offline protocol, contract and two real inputs; no Docker or runtime rehearsal

commits.subject: feat(tc1): place a read table's rows on the map from officer-stated columns and system

design: The officer opens Place on the map on an item already read as a table, picks an x/longitude and a y/latitude column or one WKT column from the read headers, and types the EPSG code; nothing is preselected and a missing code is refused with a question (422 TABLE_PLACEMENT_CRS_UNSTATED) before any write.

POST /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/intake/items/{itemId}/table-placement checks the code with the geo service and queues one fenced job, intake-table-geojson, pinned to the table source, its revision, hash and table read (lane table; a workbook reserves scratch).

writeTableGeojson streams the original through the existing readTableWindows (10,000-row windows) and writes one Feature per placeable row: the row's columns as properties, tableRow {sourceId, sourceRevision, sha256, row}, the stated system as the collection crs member; no reprojection.

Rows with no coordinates, non-numeric text, text that is not WKT of a point/line/polygon, or a workbook cell without a stored value are skipped and counted by reason, never placed at 0,0; points stay points, WKT polygons stay polygons.

The job measures, keeps the derivative through the large-original receipt (second streamed read, SHA-256 checked), records lineage in sources.inspection.tableDerivative and enrols it with IntakeService.register on the streamed GeoJSON path; officer words read e.g. 'Placed 326 rows on the map; 80 rows skipped: 80 had no coordinates.'

open: No Docker or runtime rehearsal: the job, receipt and enrolment are proven offline with fakes and the real readers; runtimeEvidence for the route stays pending in the operation manifest.
For a workbook sheet item the words are written on the workbook's own item (the source's root item), not the sheet row.
The table is read twice (measure, then keep); a very large table costs two streamed reads.
The derivative goes no further than the existing large GeoJSON path takes any dropped file: WKT polygons become footprints only through that path's normal layout step, and points stay points.

round2.review: Lead review of TC1, round 2: design accepted; eight findings fixed test first, one commit each.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'a receipt refused once with 409 is retried; no table read waits untaken and every read ends'
findings.failureShown: ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE: the refused attempt's read was left running (its table opened before the receipt took it) and its body was destroyed under it.
findings.fix: pulled() is a lazy async generator: the table is opened only when the receipt pulls its first part, and its finally destroys the stream and awaits the reader (child ended, scratch removed) before fenced() retries.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'a feature the map reader would quarantine is skipped by its own reason; Placed N is what the reader accepts'
findings.failureShown: All 6 rows were written (open ring, oversize ring, too many rings, inexact number); none skipped.
findings.fix: Each feature is checked by the streamed reader's own validator (new export streamedFeatureIssue in streaming-vector-reader.ts, carrying its 2048-position ring, 128-ring and 1 MiB feature limits; no copied constants). A refused feature is counted under open_ring, too_large, inexact_number or refused and never written; reader-accepted count equals features.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/wkt.test.ts: POINT (1 2, 3 4), MULTIPOINT ((1 2, 3 4)) and MULTIPOINT ((1 2), (3 4, 5 6)) return null (not_wkt)
findings.fix: A point and a parenthesised multipoint member take exactly one position; a second one is refused.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'a stop right after the receipt is final: the rerun finds the kept child by its lineage, never a second'; tests/large-original.test.ts: 'TC1: a table derivative's lineage is stored in the same insert as its large original'
findings.failureShown: [finals, kept] was [2, 2] (an orphan and a second derivative); finalize refused the table lineage with a ZodError.
findings.fix: LargeOriginalService.finalize takes the table-derivative/1 lineage (a discriminated union with ZL2's zip-layer/1) and stores it under inspection.tableDerivative in the insert that publishes the source; the separate UPDATE is removed.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'a small Windows-1252 table whose read pinned no reading is decoded as the table reader decoded it'; and 'a real workbook with two header rows is read in windows with the headers its bounded read pinned'
findings.failureShown: TABULAR_ENCODING: record 2 has invalid utf-8 text.
findings.fix: A CSV pin without an encoding was read whole by the bounded reader (16 MiB at most); the job reads the same bytes once and takes decodeDelimitedText's encoding and the pin's delimiter or a comma, as that reader did. A larger pin without an encoding is refused with 409 (read it as a table again).
findings.ifHeadersDiffer: The window reader compares the first window's headers with the pinned headers and refuses with 409 TABLE_PLACEMENT_HEADERS before writing any feature, so rows are never placed under other names; a re-read gives the same bounded headers, so a difference would need a fix in the reader, not a retry.

findings.where: table-geojson.ts queue, placed and stop words
findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: the queue test and 'the job keeps the derivative once with its lineage, enrols it and words the item' (records_seen and the table's words kept, placement words beside them, a second placement replacing the first's); 'a stopped placement keeps the table's own words and writes its stop beside them'
findings.failureShown: Queue gave ['reading', 0, 'Placing the rows ...'] for an item with 5 records and 'Kept as a CSV table.'; placed gave ['read', 3, 'Placed 2 rows ...']; the stop words replaced the table's words.
findings.fix: Queue, placed and stopped keep records_seen and the table's words and write "Map placement: ..." beside them (an earlier placement's words are replaced; 2000-character limit kept). The stop path was the same defect and has its own commit.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'a fault that is not a refusal stops a placement as TABLE_PLACEMENT_FAILED; the native path keeps its own code'
findings.failureShown: stopCode gave 'NATIVE_DERIVATIVE_FAILED' for the table job.
findings.fix: DerivativeJob carries a required failedCode: TABLE_PLACEMENT_FAILED for table placement, NATIVE_DERIVATIVE_FAILED for the native path.

findings.test: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-geojson.test.ts: 'enrolment: a refusal is worded on the item; a fault that is not a refusal fails the job so it is retried'
findings.failureShown: Missing expected rejection: a TypeError from register was swallowed and the job succeeded.
findings.fix: Only an AppError below 500 is kept as the officer's code; any other fault (a plain error or a 5xx) fails the job, and the rerun finds the kept child by its lineage and enrols it with the same request key.
